thread:
marco: FYI: new user ticket — blocked on our JS SDK import docs. they were trying `require('redwood-inference')` and got weird runtime errors in a serverless Edge function.

rachel: what errors exactly?

marco: two flavors: 
- on Node/CJS: `TypeError: require(...).default is not a constructor`
- on Edge (Vercel): `ReferenceError: process is not defined` or bundler pulls in node-polyfills and app fails at deploy time

tim: sounds like classic default vs named export + environment mismatch. do we publish a CJS entrypoint?

marco: yes, we have an entry at `/cjs` but users don't know that. docs only show `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'` everywhere.

rachel: we should add a tiny FAQ blurb: "I use require() — what do I do?" with copy/snippets. also call out `export { Client }` (named) vs `export default` so devs don't `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`.

docs-eng: agreed. proposed copy: "If your project uses CommonJS (require) use: `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs')`. If using ESM or Edge runtimes, use `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'`. Do not use `import Redwood from ...` — the SDK exports named symbols"

marco: also include a tiny TS note: `import type { ClientOptions } from 'redwood-inference'` and how to annotate CJS consumers: `/** @type {import('redwood-inference').ClientOptions} */`

tim: for edge runtimes we should recommend the edge bundle: `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` and note that `global`, `process`, and `fs` are not available. mention that the edge bundle is ESM-only.

rachel: can we add a one-line troubleshooting checklist in the quickstart? e.g.:
1) Confirm your runtime: Node (CJS/ESM) vs Edge
2) Pick the correct entry: `/cjs`, root (ESM), or `/edge`
3) If using TS + CJS, add JSDoc typedef for options

marco: user also reported trying `const RedwoodClient = require('redwood-inference')` then `new RedwoodClient.Client()` which failed. might be worth showing the actual exported shape in docs: `exports = { Client, utils, version }` for CJS.

docs-eng: I'll add a small code block showing `console.log(require('redwood-inference/cjs'))` output in docs so devs can quickly see shape.

devx-bot: Created issue RW-ux-504: "docs(js): clarify require vs import, named/default exports, and edge guidance" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/504

tim: sample apps: add a minimal `cjs-smoke.test.js` that runs `node` against the CJS snippet in ci to catch regressions. also add an edge smoke (vite/vercel) integration check if possible.

rachel: I'll PR the docs change and the quickstart copy. marco can you add the sample-app smoke test?

marco: yep — will open a sample-apps PR with the test and reference the issue. will also add a single-line onboarding checklist item for support: "ask what import style they use".

tim: one more: check package.json `exports` map to ensure conditional exports don't break `require('redwood-inference')` resolution in older node versions. filed RW-runtime-221 to audit.

marco: ok thanks. i think this small set of docs + sample test will address 80% of these onboarding tickets.

rachel: sweet. after PRs land let's update the support playbook snippet so L1 can triage faster.

devx-bot: PR template updated to remind authors to include CJS and ESM snippets for JS SDK docs.

marco: i'll paste PR links here once ready.
